title: chytraculia cuspidata
intro: Chytraculia cuspidata, commonly known as the African starfruit, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The plant has been traditionally used in various parts of the world for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
